### The Remission of Sins
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/remission-of-sins
Passage: Isaiah 1:18
Points:
- The biblical doctrine of justification provides the practical comfort of having our sins sent away.
- In justification, God removes our guilt by placing our sins onto Christ and crediting Christ's righteousness to us.
- Isaiah 1:18 reveals God's promise that even the darkest, scarlet stains of sin can be washed completely clean.
- This Old Covenant hope was fulfilled when Jesus bore the full penalty of sin on the cross.
- Anyone weighed down by guilt can receive complete forgiveness by placing faith in Jesus.

### When You Can’t See Your Way Out
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-december-19-2018.html
Passage: Isaiah 1:18
Points:
- Trapped firefighters were rescued only because they obeyed instructions provided from a plane flying overhead.
- Human society is surrounded by a destructive firestorm of sin and confusion with no obvious escape route.
- God sees the entire picture from above and gives clear directions to rescue us from judgment.
- We must trust God's reliable guidance rather than doubting His directions to escape spiritual peril.
